name: gmail
description: Full Gmail automation: search, read, send with attachments, reply, create drafts, archive, mark read/unread, trash emails, and manage labels.

tools.name: gmail_search_emails
tools.description: Search user's Gmail inbox, spam, or trash with query strings (e.g. 'is:unread', 'from:john@example.com', 'in:spam').

query.description: Search query string for Gmail filters.

max_results.description: Maximum number of emails to retrieve (default 5).

tools.name: gmail_get_email
tools.description: Fetch complete email details including headers (From, To, Subject, Date) and unindented body content by message ID.

tools.name: gmail_send_email
tools.description: Send a real email via Gmail API with optional file attachments.

body.description: Body text of the email message.

attachments.description: Optional list of absolute file paths to attach to the email (PDFs, images, documents, CSVs).

thread_id.description: Optional thread ID to group into an existing conversation thread.

tools.name: gmail_create_draft
tools.description: Create a new email draft in user's Gmail account without sending, with optional file attachments.

attachments.description: Optional list of absolute file paths to attach to the draft.

thread_id.description: Optional thread ID to associate draft with.

tools.name: gmail_reply_email
tools.description: Reply directly to an existing email or thread with optional file attachments.

message_id.description: Message ID of the email being replied to.

attachments.description: Optional list of absolute file paths to attach.

tools.name: gmail_archive_email
tools.description: Archive an email by removing it from the INBOX label.

tools.name: gmail_mark_as_read
tools.description: Mark an unread email as read.

message_id.description: Gmail message ID to mark as read.
Gmail message ID to mark as unread.
Gmail message ID to move to Trash.

tools.name: gmail_list_labels
tools.description: List all Gmail labels, folders, and message counts.
